packageRules.description: The Hindsight daemon moves with its hook package, behind a database backup: docs/superpowers/specs/completed/2026-11-13-hindsight-daemon-environment-and-uv-cache.md. The requires-python range is the lock's, so a bump is `uv lock --directory hindsight` in a reviewed commit
check.yml pins mise to the floor in setup/mise-floor.sh, and bin/lib/test-override-env fails when they differ. Raise both by hand in one commit
check.yml asks for the newest Python the macos-26 runner image caches (its Readme, Cached Tools), so setup-python downloads nothing. Raise it by hand when the image gains a version
